## The claim

Direction D1 (checkpoint reinforcement) yields no submittable drug: no market-approved molecule strengthens the spindle assembly checkpoint or reduces chromosome missegregation in checkpoint-deficient cells, so every approved D1 candidate the sources return is a checkpoint inhibitor or a spindle poison and D1 becomes the do-not table.

**Prediction if true.** Among approved candidates attached to D1 seed targets in the refreshed snapshot, every action type is inhibitor, antagonist or tubulin-binding; no approved molecule reaches rung 2 or higher for a checkpoint-reinforcing result in evidence.tsv; the anti-direction table holds at least one D1 drug class.

**What would refute it.** An approved molecule with a cited cellular or animal result (a PMID) showing strengthened checkpoint signalling or reduced missegregation in SAC-deficient or aneuploid cells, placing it at rung 2 or higher under D1.
